title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Numbers 3: the sons of Aaron, the families and duties of the Levites, and the redemption of the firstborn.

questions.text: Who was the firstborn son of Aaron?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 names the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

questions.text: How did Nadab and Abihu die before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says they died before Yahweh when they offered strange fire before Yahweh in the wilderness of Sinai.

answers.text: They touched the ark of the covenant
They offered strange fire before Yahweh
They refused to carry the tabernacle
They were struck by a plague in the camp

questions.text: Instead of whom did Yahweh take the Levites?
questions.explanation: Yahweh took the Levites from among Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb, for all the firstborn are his.

answers.text: Instead of the tribe of Judah
Instead of all the firstborn of Israel
Instead of the princes of the tribes

questions.text: From what age were the Levite males to be counted?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses to count every male of the children of Levi from a month old and upward.

answers.text: From a month old and upward
From twenty years old and upward
From thirty years old and upward
From five years old and upward

questions.text: Which of these was a son of Levi?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says the sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

questions.text: On which side of the tabernacle did the families of the Gershonites encamp?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says the families of the Gershonites encamped behind the tabernacle westward.

questions.text: Which Levite families had the ark, the table and the lamp stand as their duty?
questions.explanation: Verse 31 says the duty of the Kohathites was the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars and the vessels of the sanctuary.

questions.text: Who was prince of the princes of the Levites?
questions.explanation: Verse 32 says Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest was prince of the princes of the Levites.

questions.text: What was the appointed duty of the sons of Merari?
questions.explanation: Verse 36 says their duty was the tabernacle's boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets and all its instruments.

answers.text: The ark, the table and the lamp stand
The tent, its covering and the door screen
The anointing oil and the sweet incense
The boards, bars, pillars and sockets of the tabernacle

questions.text: How much was taken for each firstborn who exceeded the number of the Levites?
questions.explanation: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three extra firstborn, Moses was to take five shekels apiece and give the money to Aaron and his sons.
